title: Mexican Parmesan Pasta Bake
description: A rich and cheesy Mexican pasta bake, perfect for a cozy night in. This recipe combines the flavors of Mexico with the comfort of a pasta bake.
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chili powder and cumin to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the parmesan and portuguese cheese until melted and smooth.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and stir until well coated with the cheese sauce.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish and top with additional parmesan cheese.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
